scope: User-authorized read-only PID-scoped resource sample; no app mutations, synthetic load, builds, or concurrent regression tests

method.cpuBasis: 100 percent means one logical CPU fully utilized; machine percentage divides by logical processor count
method.privateMemoryBasis: Process private bytes (committed), not resident private working set
method.workingSetCaveat: Summed working sets may double-count shared pages
method.membershipCaveat: Short-lived descendants between tree refreshes may be missed
